data.title: Knowledge Work as a Product: Professional Services in the AI Era
data.event: Columbus AI Week 2026, AI for Business Summit · Columbus, Ohio
data.description: A fifteen-minute main stage talk on why professional services is the industry most exposed to AI. The product is knowledge work, so what AI produces is what the industry sells. Four fundamental truths about what clients buy, and how each one changes when agents do the work. Views are Jack's own.

data.title: Navigating AI Governance, Security, and Trust Across the Enterprise
data.event: Columbus AI Week 2026, AI Leadership Summit · Columbus, Ohio
data.description: A featured fireside on governance that enables rather than blocks, moderated by Jim Ford with Eric Zielinski and Connie Matthews. Jack brought the view of someone who runs autonomous coding agents at night and works inside enterprise governance by day: security as layers, gates with teeth, and evals as governance.

data.title: AnimaMesh: An Engine for Running a Company with Agents
data.description: The Company of Zero demo: one open source engine on Cloudflare Workers, a private markdown brain per company, and agents that bring me the day's work. It took second place in AI Tinkerers' global Top AI Demos that week.
